title: The window in full: 114 of 140 winners picked
alts: Formline in the international window, 12–17 November: picked the winner in 114 of the 140 matches that had one (81%); 34 draws, 7 of which it had as toss-ups. Winners picked: men's 114 of 140. Favourites given 70% or more won 49 of 57. Every call was published before kick-off.
The results nobody saw coming: Argentina 1–2 Uruguay, given 9%; Tunisia 0–2 Libya, given 12%; Lesotho 2–1 Gabon, given 12%; Portugal 1–4 Denmark, given 14%; Mozambique 0–1 Ethiopia, given 15%.
